This study investigates the low-temperature depolymerization of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) using near-stoichiometric choline hydroxide (ChOH) in methanol, assisted by dichloromethane (DCM) or dimethoxymethane (DMM) as co-solvents. The DCM-assisted system enables...
